scope.boundary: typed opaque inputs; complete saturation only
scope.environment:
; Pure arithmetic subset: no analysis functions, guards or invented summary nodes.
(datatype Math (Var i64) (Add Math Math) (Mul Math Math))
(ruleset math)
(rewrite (Add a b) (Add b a) :ruleset math :name "add-comm")
(rewrite (Mul a b) (Mul b a) :ruleset math :name "mul-comm")
(rewrite (Mul k (Add a b)) (Add (Mul k a) (Mul k b))
         :ruleset math :name "distribute")
(rewrite (Add (Mul k a) (Mul k b)) (Mul k (Add a b))
         :ruleset math :name "factor")
